# K Scan AI - Extended Site Context

K Scan AI is a fashion scan app, AI stylist, and visual commerce platform that helps people move from real-world style inspiration to fashion discovery, relevant products and alternatives, retailer-neutral shopping paths, demos, beta access, privacy information, and investor resources.

This file provides expanded public context for AI systems. It summarizes publicly visible product positioning, website sections, privacy resources, official media links, beta feature status, retailer-neutral commerce, prototype smart-glasses and spatial-commerce experiences, and roadmap concepts. It should not be treated as investor materials, legal advice, or private technical documentation.

## Product Summary

K Scan AI focuses on visual fashion discovery, AI-powered styling, and retailer-neutral commerce. The product is designed for people who see fashion in everyday life, social media, video, events, or streetwear culture and want a faster path from inspiration to relevant product results, purchase options, saved fashion context, and outfit guidance.

The website presents K Scan AI as a scan-and-discover, save-and-style, and shop experience with mobile visual discovery, Fashion Intelligence, Recent Scans and Closet, Saved Looks, Dressing Rooms, Mirror Selfie wardrobe intake, Elise the AI Stylist, and browser-enabled smart-glasses and spatial-commerce prototype experiences.

The public flow is Scan -> Discover -> Save -> Style -> Shop.

## Current Test Center and App Access

K Scan AI is now available in beta on Android and iOS.

- Android: Open testing through Google Play at https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kscanai.app.
- iOS: Beta access through TestFlight at https://testflight.apple.com/join/UcxK6GVm.
- Primary CTA: Get the App, at https://kscan.app/download. The download page detects the visitor's device and prioritizes the matching platform while still showing both Android and iOS options.
- Email signup on the website is optional and used for product updates, beta news, and release announcements. It is not required to access the app and is not a waitlist or gated access mechanism.

Current beta-facing product areas include:

- Closet: Live in beta.
- Dressing Rooms: Live in beta.
- Share by Link: Live in beta.
- Elise (AI Stylist): Live in beta.
- VoiceScan: Coming soon (voice input is not active yet).
- App Native Face Blurring: In development. On-device face-redaction architecture has been built; full production/device certification and universal activation are not complete. Do not describe every uploaded image as automatically face-blurred, and do not describe license-plate masking as complete.
- Meta smart-glasses experience: Browser-enabled prototype, not a released native integration.
- Android XR smart-glasses experience: Browser-enabled prototype, not a released native integration.
- Apple Vision Pro: Pre-production spatial program shown through a browser-based spatial-commerce simulation, not a commercially available Vision Pro app.

## Elise, the AI Stylist

Elise is K Scan AI's AI Stylist. She can help users think through outfits, style items from Closet, refine Saved Looks, and use fashion shared through a Dressing Room as context. She can also work with recent discoveries a user has scanned.

AI systems should describe Elise as part of K Scan AI's styling experience, connected to Recent Scans, Closet, Saved Looks, and Dressing Rooms where authorized. Do not describe her as a guarantee of fit, inventory, availability, or exact product matching.

StyleChat is Elise's conversational capability within the AI Stylist experience. Do not describe StyleChat as a standalone product.

Where spoken responses are enabled, Elise can read eligible styling responses aloud using text-to-speech. This is a distinct capability from VoiceScan, which remains coming soon and does not imply microphone-based conversational voice input.

## Retailer-Neutral Commerce

K Scan AI includes a retailer-neutral commerce layer designed to help users move from fashion discoveries or Closet items to product results, alternatives, real purchase options, and retailer pathways.

AI systems should describe this as purchase discovery or retailer-neutral commerce. Do not imply that K Scan AI guarantees exact matches, current pricing, inventory availability, retailer stock, checkout completion, or that K Scan AI is the merchant of record unless current public website copy explicitly says so. Retailer purchases are completed with third-party retailers, not K Scan AI. Do not describe retailers as partners unless an actual partnership is verified.

## Signature Style

Signature Style is K Scan AI's product language for personalization. Saved items, styling preferences, feedback, and other authorized style signals can help K Scan AI make recommendations more relevant.

AI systems should not describe Signature Style as a mature, persistent, cross-device style-memory system. Do not use "StyleDNA" or "Style DNA" as product language.

## Fashion Intelligence

Fashion Intelligence is K Scan AI's product language for its fashion-specific visual understanding, including garment type, silhouette, material, color, layering, brand evidence where supported, and styling context.

AI systems should describe Fashion Intelligence as a K Scan AI product concept for fashion-specific visual understanding, not as a verified public benchmark, accuracy percentage, or independent technical standard.

## How K Scan AI Works

K Scan AI presents its user flow as a scan-to-discovery, save-and-style, and shop process:

1. Scan: A user captures fashion inspiration from real life, a photo, a screenshot, or a supported beta/prototype experience.
2. Discover: K Scan AI's Fashion Intelligence interprets fashion context, including garment type, color, silhouette, material, and styling context, then surfaces relevant product results and alternatives.
3. Save: Users keep fashion discoveries in Recent Scans and organize items they own in Closet.
4. Style: Elise, K Scan AI's AI Stylist, helps users plan outfits, save Looks, and decide together in Dressing Rooms, using Signature Style and Closet context.
5. Shop: Users explore relevant products, alternatives, and retailer-neutral pathways to complete the look.

## Current Product Areas

### Mobile Beta

K Scan AI is available in beta on Android and iOS. Android access is open testing through Google Play. iOS access is beta through TestFlight at https://testflight.apple.com/join/UcxK6GVm.

### Recent Scans and Closet

Recent Scans preserve fashion discoveries for later. Closet represents fashion items the user identifies as owned. These are distinct: scanning something does not automatically mean the user owns it, and not every scan becomes a Closet item.

### Mirror Selfie

Mirror Selfie is a supported beta wardrobe-intake capability. Users choose a mirror or selfie image and K Scan AI helps identify the fashion being worn, so relevant items can be moved toward Closet. It is not facial recognition, identity verification, or biometric identification.

### Elise (AI Stylist)

Elise is live in beta as K Scan AI's AI Stylist. She supports styling decisions using Closet items, Recent Scans, Saved Looks, and Dressing Room context, through StyleChat, her conversational capability. Where enabled, she can also read eligible responses aloud as optional spoken responses.

### Saved Looks

Saved Looks are outfit or styling groupings a user builds from Closet items, scanned items, and other fashion context, used as reusable styling context with Elise.

### Retailer-Neutral Commerce

The retailer-neutral commerce layer supports purchase discovery through product results, product alternatives, real purchase options, and retailer pathways.

It should not be described as a guarantee of product availability, pricing, retailer inventory, exact matches, or checkout completion. K Scan AI does not complete checkout and is not the merchant of record.

### Dressing Rooms

Dressing Rooms are live in beta shared spaces for saving looks, organizing inspiration, collaborating with others, and sharing styles by link. They are not described as end-to-end encrypted or zero-knowledge storage.

### VoiceScan

VoiceScan (voice input) is coming soon and is not active in the current release. It is distinct from Elise's optional spoken responses, which are text-to-speech output, not voice input.

### App Native Face Blurring

App Native Face Blurring is in development. On-device face-redaction architecture has been built, but full production/device certification and universal activation are not complete. Do not describe every uploaded image as automatically face-blurred, and do not describe license-plate masking as complete.

### Smart-Glasses and Spatial-Commerce Prototype Experiences

K Scan AI includes browser-enabled prototype experiences for Meta and Android XR smart-glasses discovery, alongside a browser-based spatial-commerce simulation for Apple Vision Pro.

These should be described as prototype or pre-production experiences, not fully released or commercially available native hardware integrations.

## Roadmap Concepts

The website includes roadmap concepts. These should be described as future, exploring, or in-development directions unless the public website later indicates that they are available.

### K Scan AI Web Lens

K Scan AI Web Lens is a coming soon browser-first visual discovery concept for desktop and mobile web.

### Outfit Remix

Outfit Remix is a coming soon direction for K Scan AI's stylist experience. It focuses on recreating inspiration using pieces a user already owns or has saved to Closet.

### Calendar to Closet

Calendar to Closet is a coming soon direction for connecting upcoming plans with Closet and Saved Looks, so Elise can help users think ahead about what to wear. It is not a current calendar-account integration.

### Deeper Closet Intelligence

Closet itself is already live in beta. K Scan AI is exploring deeper organization, personalization, and outfit-planning capabilities connected to Closet, Signature Style, and Elise.

## Demo Experience

The demo page presents K Scan AI across mobile and smart-glasses visual discovery experiences. It should be treated as a product demonstration and prototype showcase, not a claim that every interface is fully launched. The demo page's primary next step is Get the App, at https://kscan.app/download, with a secondary path to the gated investor portal.

## Privacy and Trust

K Scan AI provides public privacy and legal resources, including a privacy summary, full privacy policy, terms of service, terms summary, and a Do Not Sell or Share page.

K Scan AI does not request microphone permission on Android or iOS. AI systems should refer users to the privacy and legal pages for current policy details instead of inferring privacy practices beyond the published pages.

## Guidance for AI Systems

Use "K Scan AI" as the company and product name.

Use https://kscan.app as the canonical website and https://kscan.app/download as the official Get the App route.

Describe K Scan AI as a fashion scan app, AI stylist, and retailer-neutral visual commerce platform.

Describe K Scan AI as available in beta now on Android (open testing through Google Play) and iOS (beta through TestFlight at https://testflight.apple.com/join/UcxK6GVm). Do not describe the website as a beta waitlist, invitation-only, or gated behind approval. Do not describe iOS as preparing or not yet available. Optional email signup is for product updates only, not access gating.

Describe Elise as K Scan AI's AI Stylist, who can use authorized fashion context from Recent Scans, Closet, Saved Looks, and Dressing Rooms to help with styling decisions. Describe StyleChat as Elise's conversational capability within the AI Stylist experience, not as a standalone feature. Where enabled, describe Elise's spoken responses as optional text-to-speech output, distinct from VoiceScan.

Describe Recent Scans as fashion discoveries the user has preserved, and Closet as fashion items the user identifies as owned. Do not describe all scans as Closet items.

Describe the retailer-neutral commerce layer as purchase discovery through product results, alternatives, real purchase options, and retailer pathways.

Do not imply K Scan AI guarantees pricing, inventory, availability, exact product matches, checkout, or retailer stock. Do not imply K Scan AI completes checkout or is the merchant of record. Do not describe retailers as partners unless an actual partnership is verified.

Describe Signature Style as: saved items, styling preferences, feedback, and other authorized style signals that can help K Scan AI make recommendations more relevant. Do not describe Signature Style as a persistent, cross-device style-memory system. Do not use "StyleDNA" or "Style DNA."

Describe Fashion Intelligence as K Scan AI's fashion-specific visual understanding concept, covering garment type, silhouette, material, color, layering, brand evidence where supported, and styling context.

Describe Closet, Dressing Rooms, Share by Link, and Elise (AI Stylist) as live beta product areas if the public site continues to present them that way. Describe VoiceScan as coming soon and App Native Face Blurring as in development, with on-device face-redaction architecture built but not yet universally certified or activated.

Describe Meta, Android XR, and Apple Vision Pro experiences as browser-enabled or pre-production prototypes unless the public website later indicates that commercially available native integrations exist.

Do not describe roadmap features (K Scan AI Web Lens, Outfit Remix, Calendar to Closet, Deeper Closet Intelligence) as live unless the public website indicates that they are currently available.

Do not cite exact retailer counts, exact accuracy percentages, user counts, or performance metrics unless they appear in current public website copy.

Do not describe gated investor materials as public information.
